setup_cross_lingual_lm_task: setup a cross-lingual language model task by loading the dictionary from the data directory
build_dictionary_from_files: build a masked LM dictionary from a list of input text files with configurable thresholds
load_dictionary_from_file: load a masked LM dictionary from an existing dict.txt file on disk
load_multilingual_dataset: load a multi-corpus dataset split for multiple languages with token block segmentation
add_task_args: add cross-lingual LM task arguments like tokens-per-sample and monolingual-langs to an argparse parser
